title: She Fooled Royal Doctors Into Believing She Birthed Rabbits 🐇
caption:
True story. In 1726 Mary Toft convinced doctors she was giving birth to rabbits. The king even sent his own surgeon. 🐇
Would you have believed her? 👇
first_comment: A whole royal medical team believed it for weeks. How gullible would YOU be in 1726? 🐇👇
